rationale: The paper's main screen is the A375 dCas9-KRAB CRISPRi screen of melanoma HRR-associated enhancers (9,977 guides over 804 enhancer core regions plus 1,000 non-targeting guides, each its own N_<i> id), day 21 versus day 0 with two replicates each (MAGeCK; Table S7 'A375 day21'). Its 66 positively selected enhancers (silencing speeds growth, tumour-suppressive candidates such as E_349, E_156 near PTEN, E_409 near NF1) are the headline, so enrichment is the direction compared. Replicate 1/2 labels carry no evidence of pairing, so no replicate term. The A375 day-7 and SK-MEL-2 libraries added in 2023 are bottlenecked (55-76% of guides at zero, top 1% of guides holding 11-19% of reads) and are not analysed; they are kept in the merged count file only.
